weekly_objective: Keep the committed Tuesday double and Thursday's threshold and strength day, then absorb them with easy aerobic riding while HRV is unbalanced.
coach_says: Your HRV has dropped to unbalanced (36 ms last night, 7-day average 42 ms, just under your 43-55 ms baseline), and resting HR is a few beats up, so I've trimmed the weekend instead of adding anything. Friday's easy MTB stays as planned. Saturday's Workout B keeps the heavy lifts but at half the lower-body volume, with a short yoga flow to replace Wednesday's missed session, and Sunday's ride is cut from 120 to 90 minutes, all in zone 2. Monday's missed swim isn't rescheduled because you swam on Tuesday anyway; just keep sleeping well, as that's what's holding things together.

days.details:
Warmup: 200 m easy (100 m freestyle, 100 m backstroke or drill)
Main set: 4x150 m steady aerobic freestyle at RPE 4-5, 20 s rest between reps
Cooldown: 200 m easy, mixed strokes
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Flush the legs and add easy aerobic volume on a wet day without any fatigue going into Tuesday's double.

days.session: Committed double: AM controlled hills road ride + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM hills road ride (before work):
60 min | Controlled climbing, saving the legs for the evening | Z2, climbs at low Z3 max, RPE 4-5
Structure: 15 min Z1-2 warm-up, then 35 min on your usual hill loop climbing seated and controlled (no climb above low Z3, no sprints or Strava efforts), then 10 min easy spin home.
Heavy drizzle is forecast: lights on, slightly lower tyre pressure, brake early on descents.

PM MTB group ride (after work):
90 min | Committed hard group ride | Surges Z4-Z5, RPE 7-9 on climbs
Structure: 10-15 min easy before the group rolls, then race the climbs and recover fully on descents and at regroups.
Trails will be wet, so ride within your skill margin.
Fuelling: carb-rich snack 60-90 min before; 30-60 g carbs/h plus a bottle during; protein and carb recovery meal within an hour after.
days.fallback: If HRV is well below baseline or resting HR is 5+ bpm above average (or the roads are slick), replace the AM ride with 45 min indoor Z1-2 spin or skip it. Still ride the PM group ride, but sit in, cap efforts at RPE 7 and skip the sprints.

days.details:
Recovery yoga, 40-45 min: hip flexors, hamstrings, glutes, thoracic spine and calves, with slow nasal breathing throughout.
Optional: 20-30 min easy walk outside (dry, overcast day).
No riding today, so you recover fully from Tuesday.

days.session: AM threshold intervals + lunch Workout A
days.details:
AM ride (before work):
50 min | Threshold development | Z4 work intervals, RPE 7
Warm-up: 12 min Z1-2 building, including 2x30 s high cadence
Main set: 3 x 8 min Z4 (steady, controlled, not all-out) with 4 min Z1-2 recovery between reps
Cool-down: 6 min Z1
Conditions: dry but breezy (gusts to ~28 km/h). Use a sheltered climb or loop, or the trainer if it's gusty.

Lunch gym (~6 h after the ride):
Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min easy bike, glute bridges and leg swings, 2 ramp-up sets of squats
Back Squat 3x6 (first heavy session in weeks: 3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 3x8 (2-3 RIR)
Single-arm Dumbbell Row 3x8/side
Pallof Press 3x10/side
Side Plank 3x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets; 60-90 s for the other exercises
Objective: Re-establish heavy lower-body strength for cycling economy without leaving soreness that carries into the weekend.
days.fallback: If signals are poor: ride the 50 min fully in Z2 with no intervals, and do Workout A with 2 sets per exercise at 3 RIR, keeping the same loads.

days.details:
75 min | Aerobic endurance, flushing the legs | Z1-2, RPE 3, conversational
Structure: steady Z2 on flowing trails. Soft-pedal or walk the steep pitches rather than surging, and keep every effort at Z2 or below.
Conditions: overcast, 42% chance of rain but no measurable rain forecast, wind up to ~26 km/h. If it does rain, swap for 60 min indoor Z2.
HRV is unbalanced, so keep this truly easy. If HRV is still under ~40 ms on Friday morning, cut the ride to 60 min.

days.session: Workout B (lunch, reduced volume) + yoga flow
days.details:
Workout B:
Warm-up: 5 min rower, glute bridges, 2 ramp-up sets of split squats
Bulgarian Split Squat 2x6/side (3 RIR, same load as planned)
Hip Thrust 2x8 (3 RIR)
Lat Pulldown 3x8 (2 RIR)
Dead Bug 3x8/side
Copenhagen Plank 2x20s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between split squat and hip thrust sets; 60-90 s for the other exercises
Objective: Keep the week's second heavy strength stimulus while halving lower-body volume, so Sunday's ride and next Tuesday's double aren't compromised while HRV is unbalanced.
After the session: 15 min yoga flow (hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, slow breathing) to replace Wednesday's missed yoga. Indoors, as light drizzle is forecast.
days.fallback: If HRV is still below ~40 ms or resting HR is 5+ bpm above average: skip the split squats and hip thrusts, do Lat Pulldown, Dead Bug and Copenhagen Plank only, then 30 min yoga. Or replace the whole session with 45 min recovery yoga.

days.details:
90 min | Aerobic base | Z2, RPE 3-4
Structure: 15 min Z1 warm-up, 65 min steady Z2 on rolling roads (keep the climbs in Z2), 10 min Z1 cool-down.
Fuelling: 40-60 g carbs/h starting in the first 30 min, plus 500-750 ml fluid/h; warm and humid (up to ~29°C).
Conditions: light drizzle possible (~0.9 mm), wind up to ~24 km/h. Lights on, and ride into the wind on the way out. If the roads are properly wet, ride 75 min Z2 on the trainer instead.
Shortened from 120 min because HRV is unbalanced. No surges or hard climbs.
